facts.claim: TextileMode Manufacturing ERP deployment
facts.evidence: Live production deployment at https://erp.textilemode.com with active ERP ledger and loom management.
facts.footnote: Verified via live production system at erp.textilemode.com.

facts.claim: Loom count actively managed in production
facts.evidence: Production planning and loom allocation module managing 27 air-jet and shuttle looms.
facts.footnote: Case Study 01: TextileMode ERP (production planning module).

facts.claim: System modules and analytical reports built
facts.evidence: Modules covering yarn inventory, loom scheduling, greige inspection, payroll piece-rate, and financial close.
facts.footnote: TextileMode ERP system specification and deployed report suite.

facts.claim: Manual roles transitioned to software workflows
facts.evidence: Eliminated manual paper log tallying, manual loom allocation ledgers, and duplicate spreadsheet entry across 5 staff posts.
facts.footnote: TextileMode operational audit: 5 clerical data entry roles replaced permanently by software.

facts.claim: Weekly manual clerical work eliminated
facts.evidence: Shift-change registers and physical ledger transcription automated into real-time shift tablet entries.
facts.footnote: Measured weekly hours across shift supervisors and accounting reconcilers.

facts.claim: Continuous live production operation with financial data
facts.evidence: Continuous operational uptime with live double-entry journals and inventory valuations since launch.
facts.footnote: Verified against production deployment logs at erp.textilemode.com.

facts.claim: Channels unified into a single operational interface

facts.footnote: Belhide Stack architecture: unified cross-channel telemetry.

facts.claim: Daily automated operational executive briefing

facts.claim: Automated ledger matching engine for multi-channel bank feeds
facts.evidence: Production financial reconciliation suite matching banking transactions and invoices line by line.
facts.footnote: Accounting Suite Case Study.

facts.claim: Month-end reconciliation close duration reduction
facts.evidence: Deterministic matching engine matching banking statements against purchase invoices and GL lines.
facts.footnote: Measured month-end accounting close timeline across 3 consecutive cycles.

facts.claim: Automated ledger matching accuracy rate
facts.evidence: 98% of clean banking and invoice lines match deterministically; exceptions routed to human review queue.
facts.footnote: Financial Reconciliation Engine evaluation dataset.

facts.claim: Deterministic staging table pattern for model outputs
facts.evidence: Architectural separation where LLMs propose to staging and deterministic code asserts constraints before commit.
facts.footnote: Production Agent Pipeline Architecture.

facts.claim: Deterministic staging validation pass rate
facts.evidence: Evaluated on 2,500 historical test invoices against typed schema, range checks, and ledger reconciliation tests.
facts.footnote: Agent Staging Pipeline: test suite eval on synthetic and historical supplier invoices.

facts.claim: LLM operational execution cost per 100 invoice lines
facts.evidence: Token usage benchmark on Gemini Flash / Claude Sonnet with structured JSON schema outputs.
facts.footnote: Evaluated over 50 automated invoice extraction runs in production staging.

facts.claim: Corrupted rows committed to production database
facts.evidence: Strict deterministic SQL constraints, type guards, and foreign key checks before commit guarantee zero dirty rows.
facts.footnote: Architectural principle: models propose to staging; only validated code commits.

agentCapabilities.name: Finance & Accounting Ops
agentCapabilities.description: Continuous transaction matching across bank feeds, purchase invoices, and sub-ledgers. Flags discrepancies to human queues.
agentCapabilities.metricsTracked: Match rate %, variance resolution time, close duration

agentCapabilities.name: Inventory & Procurement
agentCapabilities.description: Monitors shift consumption rates and physical stock depletion. Compiles automated reorder proposals against supplier MOQs.
agentCapabilities.metricsTracked: Stockout frequency, days of supply, buffer deviation

agentCapabilities.name: Executive & Operational Briefings
agentCapabilities.description: Ingests sales, returns, floor yield, and ad telemetry at 06:30; delivers an executive bullet digest and anomaly flags at 07:00.
agentCapabilities.metricsTracked: Daily delivery uptime, anomaly detection precision

agentCapabilities.name: Document & Invoice Intake
agentCapabilities.description: Extracts structured tables from scanned supplier PDFs, packing slips, and email attachments into an uncommitted staging schema.
agentCapabilities.metricsTracked: Field extraction accuracy, human intervention rate

agentCapabilities.name: Multi-Channel Reconciliation

agentCapabilities.name: Monitoring & Anomaly Alarms

agentCapabilities.metricsTracked: Mean time to alarm, false alarm rate
